identities.contract: user-approved stabilization closure at collector request ownership

review.scope: final ownership lifecycle dependency compatibility and evidence review

source_edits.scope: local production code and regression tests

repository_discipline.rationale: The repair is selected at the FADA composition root and lifecycle behavior remains in the shared runner owner.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Runner owns spawn, cooperative retirement, join, exit inspection and handle closure; artifact owner seals request identity.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The existing runtime/collect interface is preserved and generic callers retain persistent mode by default.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: FADA builder selects request scope without leaking simulator or CUDA behavior into scripts or learner code.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: After each successful FADA request no collector process or error-pipe handle remains; cleanup failure rejects the result.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The diff extends existing lifecycle and persistence Pinch Points and adds no alternate collector protocol.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 1095 tests plus static checks prove offline contracts only; remote native stability and policy quality are not claimed.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Artifacts are CPU-normalized before atomic save and tensor fields, roles, masks, shapes and devices are unchanged.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint activation, shared-weight version checks, replay mutation and optimizer update order are unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Request identity is persisted and checked before replay; stale or incomplete artifacts fail closed.

residual_risks.description: The exact low-level native corrupter is unproven and a failure wholly contained within one request could recur.
residual_risks.disposition: One bounded official server transaction is the only remaining confirmation; recurrence must extend this same stabilization receipt rather than resume print probing.
